interest: This single-sheet file index provides a concise archival record of interwar naval diplomacy and foreign relations between Japan and Canada. It highlights the routine overseas voyages of the Japanese Training Squadron to the Pacific coast of North America in the spring of 1933, showing how U.S. consular officials monitored and reported foreign naval movements in neighboring Canadian waters. Additionally, the cross-reference notation directs researchers to related State Department decimal files concerning Japanese naval port calls.
overview: This file consists of a single-page Department of State 'List of Papers' (Form DS-46) dated October 12, 1945, covering decimal file 894.3342 concerning visits of Japanese naval vessels and aircraft to Canadian ports. The sole listed entry indexes Despatch No. 1382 from American Consul General Ely E. Palmer in Vancouver, dated April 11, 1933, which reported on the visit of the Japanese Training Squadron to Vancouver on April 5, 1933, with a notation cross-referencing the underlying document to file 894.3311/168.

subfiles.about: A Department of State list of papers indexing records relating to visits of Japanese naval vessels to Canadian ports.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State List of Papers (Form DS-46), prepared on October 12, 1945, catalogues documents under decimal file 894.3342 regarding visits of Japanese naval vessels to Canadian ports. It records a single entry for Despatch No. 1382 sent by Consul Palmer from Vancouver on April 11, 1933. The despatch reported the arrival and visit of the Japanese Training Squadron in Vancouver on the morning of April 5, 1933, and notes a cross-reference to decimal file 894.3311/168.
subfiles.title: Department of State List of Papers: Visits of Japanese Navy Vessels to Canadian ports
